why: Pinterest rejects links to getaftergrow.com as spam (Tailwind failureReason blocked_spam: 'Pinterest blocked this link because it may lead to spam or inappropriate content'). The domain was registered 2026-09-30, and the block hit on the very first pin, the same pattern other brand-new claimed domains reported in Sept-Oct 2026.

appeal.who: George (needs his Pinterest login). Claude cannot file it.

canary_rule: While blocked: at most ONE canary queued at a time and at most 2 canary attempts in any 7 days (an attempt = a canary whose publish time passed; a deleted or missed canary does not count). The next canary is chosen by engine/autopilot.py next-canary: a ready pin that was never blocked, on a page not yet tried in this block. If George reports the appeal approved, test at once. When a canary publishes, mode becomes live.
notes: 2026-10-11: A01 failed blocked_spam at 17:35 UTC. The other 33 queued posts were deleted before they could fail, except B04, kept as the canary (Tue Oct 13, 6:09 PM ET). Deleting a queued post does not refund its Tailwind credit.
